study type: secondary analysis of a prospective, randomized controlled trial
cohort: 87 obese women (BMI ≥ 30 and < 35 kg/m2) undergoing IVF treatment
finding: Weight intervention in obese women undergoing IVF did not have a significant impact on mean birthweight or deviation from expected birthweight.
mod_finding: This study found no negative impact of a weight intervention program for obese women undergoing IVF on mean birthweight or deviation from expected birthweight.
birth_weight: Intervention group: 3486 g (SD 523); Control group: 3584 g (SD 509)
